scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. Seven boards from five live Russia-lane games of 2026-11-09, each the run's events.jsonl cut at the turn's first state frame. Both arms carry faith-strike-wipes-the-spreaders and run one frozen civvis_orders --resumed built from this branch with the run's own requested genome; the on arm adds --with faith-strike-at-a-quiet-parity. On six boards the rival's steady power was 0.74 to 0.94 of ours: the off arm holds on the 0.7 edge, and the on arm's orders add a war declaration and 2 or 3 CONDEMN_HERETIC orders. The seventh (142418Z t129) is a control: the edge clears but too few spreaders can be reached, and the orders are unchanged. An eighth case (165525Z t135) could not run because its summary has no forced list; its error is retained in the archive and it is not a member.
